text:
QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or the `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself via the setter, but never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter. It also never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C. It calls the allocator "just another runtime substitution", which gestures at the item without stating the uniqueness claim.
